summary: Client singleton queue of light cull-flag changes (which views/passes a light is culled from), filled by ecl::invisibility::EffectSystem::ApplyVisibilityToEntities (Toolkit EoCClient.dll+0xAF6F50; macOS: ecl::invisibility::EffectSystem::Update writes ls::SetLightCullFlagsRequestsSingletonComponent) and drained by the renderer side. Element type ls::LightCullFlagRequest (assert string).

fields.name: Light
fields.evidence: ApplyVisibilityToEntities: element +0 = a local copy of the key being iterated (entity handles of a per-light hash map, the light entities whose visibility is applied).

fields.name: Flags
fields.evidence: Same push: the second qword of the element is written as a 16-bit local flag word in its low two bytes with uninitialised stack bytes above it - bits 0x200 and 0x400 set/cleared from per-view visibility bytes, the rest filled by EffectSystemHelper vfunc +0x28.

fields.name: _PadA
fields.evidence: upper 6 bytes of the second qword are not meaningful (written together with the flag word from uninitialised stack bytes).

fields.name: Requests
fields.evidence: ApplyVisibilityToEntities: grow check capacity (+8) vs size (+0xC), IndexedStorage<ls::LightCullFlagRequest>::CheckBoundary, element stride 0x10 (buffer pointer plus i times 0x10). Live: heap pointer, capacity 0x20..0x100, size 0 (drained).

open_questions: Meaning of individual flag bits (0x200/0x400 are per-view visibility bits).
raw_check: 10 instances, se-fork/coverage/check.py raw stage, game v4.76.31.656
